highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too, so that credit image and video tools, location requests and many fixes work there.
Ask an agent for an image or a video with OpenBot credits. An approval card shows the model, the price and the prompt first. Each account gets 10 free welcome credits.
Let agents pay sites in crypto from a NEAR Intents wallet. Each payment waits for your approval, and a daily budget limits the spend.
Allow or block a website's location request from the chat of an agent's browser tab.
Use sidebar tabs above the chat list to see All chats, Unread chats or the folders that you choose.
